limits: All proposed tiers require independent review. A test driver tier does not reduce its tested production module tier.
The AST inventory preserves runtime value imports and recursively inventories calls/constructors; it is a reading aid, not sound side-effect analysis or blanket exclusion authority.
Assertion arguments were summarized for display; complete call traversal is retained. No complete assertion-quality, numerical coverage or runtime failure proof claimed.
Chart generation reads installed bundle text; no browser execution or HTML publication. Domain hashing/UUID dependencies are not described as filesystem-free runtime purity.
Individual metric applicability remains open; all selected test drivers remain in measure mode.
